verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents shipping physical corporate cards worldwide and, separately, inviting team members with customizable roles and permissions while issuing unlimited cards. The core of the story is present, but the evidence never says whether the cards are debit or credit, and never shows that cards are tied to or governed by an employee's defined role. Missing for 10: explicit debit vs credit card type options, documented linkage between employee roles and card issuance or controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of physical card issuance.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can issue physical debit or credit cards to employees with defined roles

citations.quote: Ship physical cards worldwide and instantly create virtual cards for your entire team, all for free.
Invite 1 or 1,000+ team members, customize roles & permissions, and issue unlimited corporate cards everywhere your team operates.
Corporate Cards: Issue physical and virtual cards with built-in expense controls.
Team Management: Add your entire company and manage user permissions.
